flashcard_questions.q: The part of a cell that contains chromosomes made of DNA and controls the cell's activities.
Structures found in the nucleus made of DNA molecules, each carrying a large number of genes.
The series of stages a cell goes through to grow, replicate its DNA, and divide into two identical daughter cells.

flashcard_questions.a: A type of cell division that produces two genetically identical daughter cells from one parent cell.
An undifferentiated cell that can divide to produce more cells of the same type and can differentiate into specialised cells.
